title: 'We are watching you' postcard
place_text: Bryce Zable's home address, Los Angeles

tellings.quote: A year before when we're shooting the pilot, um I get a postcard to my home address and it's got a picture on the front cover.

plain: In 1995, a year before the pilot of his TV show was shot, the television writer and producer Bryce Zabel says a postcard came to his home address in Los Angeles. On the front was the cover of a book called Flying Eyes and the words "WE ARE WATCHING YOU." Zabel tells Michels this as the man who got it, and he takes it as a sign that someone was paying close attention to a UFO show before it even aired.
